name: Quality Food Company
old_description: Southern New England's Leading Wholesale Restaurant Distributor and Food Service Supplier
about:
Quality Food Company operates from West Warwick, Rhode Island, where it has served as a family-owned wholesale restaurant and food supply business since its founding in 1931. The company began as a local distributor and grew into one of the largest wholesale restaurant distributors in the state.

The company distributes a broad range of food and non-food products organized into categories including proteins, portion-controlled items, paper goods, produce, seafood, and janitorial supplies. It maintains a custom cutting room for fresh beef, pork, poultry, and veal, and runs daily delivery routes covering all of Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and southeastern Connecticut. A cash-and-carry operation at its 40 Keyes Way facility provides same-day pickup for smaller orders.

Customers include independent restaurants, markets, delis, institutions, and commissaries throughout southern New England. The distributor has built a significant portion of its business around specialty cuisine markets, supplying ingredients for Italian, Asian, Brazilian, Portuguese, pub-and-tavern, and breakfast concepts, as well as serving Spanish, Portuguese, Brazilian, and Asian community establishments.

Quality Food Company emphasizes its custom cutting room and daily fresh deliveries as core differentiators, along with a commitment to smaller family-owned operators that larger broadline distributors may overlook. Free delivery on orders above $1,500–$2,000 and a product assortment tailored to ethnic and regional menus round out its value proposition.
